messages.subject: ColVis Button Positioning with CSS
parts:
I edited the CSS code in Firefox's Inspector tool to get the button to be above the left side of the table.

div.ColVis{
    float:left;
    margin-bottom:3em
}

button.ColVis_Button,ul.ColVis_collection li{
    position:absolute;
 ...

I copied this code into ui.R, but the button is still at the right side of the browser display. How should it be done ?

  tags$head(
    tags$style(HTML("
div.ColVis{
    float:left;
    margin-bottom:3em
}

button.ColVis_Button,ul.ColVis_collection li{
    position:absolute;
}
    "))
  )

Hopefully, there could be a simple option in R, once the Buttons extension is available.

messages.subject: Re: ColVis Button Positioning with CSS
parts:
1. check the source code of your shiny-app on web browser. 
2. If your css style comes early than other css file, then your style will be over written with the later css.
3. Find the the css file come with your shiny-app, and modify from its source. 

It should solve your problem.
